description: This file is a shell script used to test and verify the graphical representation of git commit history graphs under various configurations and options. It sets up git repositories with commits, branches, merges, and tags, then runs graphing commands with different flags to ensure correct visual output.

methods.name: check_graph
methods.description: A helper function that outputs the expected graph (`cat >expect`) and compares the actual graph produced by `lib_test_cmp_graph` with the expected output.
